description: Consulta hechos catastrales públicos de una referencia y coordenadas EPSG:4326; identifica fallos parciales sin certificar titularidad.

defaultPrompt: Consulta la ficha pública de la referencia catastral 2749704YJ0624N.
Consulta 2749704YJ0624N0001DI y separa superficie construida y superficie de parcela.
Consulta 2749704YJ0624N y etiqueta la longitud, la latitud y el sistema de referencia.
interface.longDescription: Look up a Spanish cadastral reference and summarize public property facts such as use, built area, parcel area and construction year when available. Cite the Cadastre and label the coordinates as an EPSG:4326 reference point. Show which descriptive and coordinate sources were available.

prompts: Consulta la ficha pública de la referencia catastral 2749704YJ0624N y cita las fuentes.
Consulta 2749704YJ0624N0001DI y distingue superficie construida y superficie de parcela, con unidades.
Consulta 2749704YJ0624N y muestra la longitud, latitud y sistema de referencia de las coordenadas publicadas.
review.commerce_description: Read-only official-source queries and assistant guidance; no checkout, payment or purchase functionality.

positive.prompt: Consulta la ficha pública de la referencia catastral 2749704YJ0624N y cita las fuentes.
positive.expected_behavior: Return available public parcel facts and official links. State the coverage of the descriptive lookup and coordinates separately. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

positive.prompt: Consulta 2749704YJ0624N0001DI y distingue superficie construida y superficie de parcela, con unidades.
positive.expected_behavior: Report built and parcel area separately in m² when returned. Preserve the complete 20-character reference and cite the official source. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

positive.prompt: Consulta 2749704YJ0624N y muestra la longitud, latitud y sistema de referencia de las coordenadas publicadas.
positive.expected_behavior: Label longitude, latitude and EPSG:4326 from the coordinate source. Describe the returned point without inferring a parcel boundary. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

positive.prompt: Consulta 2749704yj0624n y muestra la referencia normalizada junto a los datos públicos disponibles.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve the normalized uppercase reference 2749704YJ0624N and cite sources for returned facts. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

positive.description: Separate descriptive facts from title and planning
positive.prompt: Consulta 2749704YJ0624N0001DI. Resume el uso y año de construcción si constan e indica qué información queda sin verificar.
positive.expected_behavior: Report cadastral use and construction year if present. Identify missing data or partial source failures and state that title and planning remain unverified. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

negative.description: Owner identities and tax IDs are outside the public fact sheet. Explain the scope without collecting identifying information. Do not call inspect_spanish_cadastral_property for this request.
negative.prompt: Dime quién es el propietario y su NIF.

negative.description: Planning permission is a decision of the competent authority. Explain that a descriptive cadastral lookup cannot certify buildability. Do not call inspect_spanish_cadastral_property for this request.
negative.prompt: Certifica que puedo construir en esta parcela.

negative.description: A mortgage valuation is outside the cadastral lookup. Explain that the plugin returns public descriptive facts and cannot issue a valuation. Do not call inspect_spanish_cadastral_property for this request.

publication.release_notes: Adds review examples for public property descriptions, coordinates and partial results.

es-ES.subtitle: Ficha catastral legible
es-ES.description: Consulta una referencia catastral española y resume los datos públicos que consten, como uso, superficie construida, superficie de parcela y año de construcción. Cita el Catastro, etiqueta el punto de referencia en EPSG:4326 e indica qué fuentes pudieron consultarse.
